items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: La Vida was Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Fleischer on guitar. Robert Davis on drums and Bennett Turner on piano

ctx.x: Orchestrations? No, no. For everybody. How many players do they have? About five or six in the band? Six of them. Six. At the
La Vida was Jim, Paul Barnes, Sidney Fleischer on guitar. Robert Davis on drums and Bennett Turner on piano which is a real good musician.
What happened to Turner? Is he still around? Does he play? I haven't heard of him.
